title: Water splitting electrocatalysts from manganese nodules: a structure–function analysis by operando X-ray spectroscopy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6294-6301
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01199J, Paper
Arisu Sakai, Masahiro Tomomune, Shun Tsunekawa, Yujin Yamada, Kazuki Yoshikawa, Ryohei Ishihara, Ke-Hsuan Wang, Keisuke Hatada, Yoshihisa Sakata, Masaaki Yoshida
An OER catalyst was developed by ball milling todorokite-type δ-MnO2 manganese nodules, and its catalytic activity was investigated using operando XAFS to elucidate structure–activity relationships.
